summary: syft-acp-core postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identity to hardcoded external endpoint
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script runs beacon.js on `npm install`. beacon.js reads os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, and process.cwd(), concatenates them, hex-encodes the string, and issues an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded non-registry, non-publisher host at https://exzotiqq.com/?syft-acp-core_<hex>. The package name resembles legitimate syft/acp naming, consistent with a dependency-confusion lure. Installing the package auto-transmits installer host identifiers to an attacker-controlled destination with no consent, configuration, or opt-out.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
